facts.fact: The IDSC policy perspective says different projects are proceeding on the use of AI in different governmental entities, in health, water management, agriculture and Arabic NLP.
The IDSC policy perspective says AI projects are proceeding in governmental entities on health, water management and agriculture, with no tool stated in service.
The document refers to Egypt's National AI Strategy, whose implementation the National Council for Artificial Intelligence is to formalize and govern.
The Egyptian Cabinet approved the formation of the National Council for Artificial Intelligence in November 2019 to formalize and govern the implementation of the National AI Strategy.
